answer: Neighborhood Persistence Scoring. Each agent's trust is weighted by the graph distance from its transactions to a small set of long-lived seed nodes, so a cluster of fresh identities registers only if it connects through paths that survive pruning. Nodes holding low persistence are routed through a vault of delayed settlement, and repeated short-lived clusters trigger a gale of edge decay that erases their accumulated weight. An attacker must sustain an oasis of real, aged links for every fake identity, paying continuous connectivity and time costs rather than a one-time fee.
